## Type of Change

- [ ] `fix` — Bug fix (non-breaking, resolves an issue)
- [ ] `feat` — New feature (non-breaking, adds functionality)
- [ ] `refactor` — Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `docs` — Documentation only change
- [ ] `style` — Formatting, whitespace, or naming (no logic change)
- [ ] `perf` — Performance improvement
- [ ] `build` — Dependency, CI/CD, or tooling change
- [ ] `breaking` — Breaking change (existing functionality is affected)
